title: Agentic AI accelerates 3D IC engineering for the AI factory era
gist: Siemens, announcing at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, expanded its EDA agentic AI portfolio: the Fuse EDA AI Agent plus Intelligence Center X orchestrate nine workflow stages across seven Siemens EDA tools, cutting setup effort up to 95% and enabling up to 50x more 3D IC design alternatives to be evaluated. The piece, by a Siemens 3D IC R&D manager, argues electrothermal co-design must move to the start of the design cycle as AI-factory packages get denser.

insights.claim: Siemens expanded its EDA agentic AI portfolio at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, developed in collaboration with NVIDIA.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Deepens the Siemens-NVIDIA alliance in AI-driven EDA, a competitive front against Synopsys and Cadence.
insights.quote: At NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, Siemens announced an expansion of its EDA agentic AI portfolio, developed in collaboration with NVIDIA.

insights.claim: Siemens' Fuse EDA AI Agent integrated with Intelligence Center X orchestrates nine automated workflow stages across seven Siemens EDA tools, reducing setup effort by up to 95 percent.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Vendor-claimed productivity gains of this scale strengthen the case that agentic EDA lowers design labor cost per chip.
insights.quote: reducing setup effort by up to 95 percent
insights.locator: At the center of this innovation

insights.claim: Siemens claims its agentic workflow lets engineering teams evaluate up to 50 times more 3D IC design alternatives.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: More design-space exploration per schedule could become a key differentiator in AI accelerator packaging.
insights.quote: This automation enables engineering teams to evaluate up to 50 times more design alternatives
insights.locator: At the center of this innovation

insights.claim: In Siemens' agentic model, engineers define a design objective and the AI agent coordinates multi-tool workflows, runs coupled electrothermal simulations, identifies missed targets, and diagnoses whether the root cause is power delivery, placement, material selection, or their interaction.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Shifts the engineer's role from workflow coordinator to decision-maker, changing EDA's value proposition from tools to outcomes.
insights.locator: The agent runs coupled electrothermal simulations

insights.claim: Siemens uses NVIDIA Agent Toolkit, NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms and CUDA-X libraries so that faster simulation turnaround feeds more results for the agent to evaluate.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: GPU-accelerated simulation is becoming the throughput bottleneck-breaker for agentic EDA, expanding NVIDIA's footprint in EDA compute.
insights.quote: Siemens leverages NVIDIA Agent Toolkit alongside NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms and CUDA-X libraries.
insights.locator: To support these advanced engineering workflows

insights.claim: Traditional EDA workflows relying on extensive manual coordination cannot keep pace with the increasing complexity of advanced 3D IC architectures, according to Siemens.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Positions agentic automation as a necessity, not an option, for advanced packaging design.
insights.quote: Traditional workflows that rely on extensive manual coordination cannot keep pace with the increasing complexity of advanced 3D IC architectures.

insights.claim: As compute and memory are brought closer together in tightly integrated 3D packages, power density rises and heat becomes more concentrated, so thermal behavior can no longer be addressed late in the design cycle.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Electrothermal co-design moves upstream, raising demand for early-stage multiphysics simulation tools.
insights.quote: Thermal behavior can no longer be addressed late in the design cycle; electrothermal co-design must be a primary consideration from the earliest stages of development.

insights.claim: AI factory silicon must deliver more compute performance and memory bandwidth while improving thermal efficiency within increasingly constrained physical footprints.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Packaging and thermal management become first-order constraints on AI hardware scaling.
insights.locator: AI factories are reshaping semiconductor requirements

insights.claim: Because time and compute limits restrict how many coupled power-thermal-performance scenarios teams evaluate, bottlenecks in 3D IC designs can stay hidden until late in the design process when changes are costly.
insights.speaker: Admin
insights.so_what: Late-discovered thermal or power issues drive costly respins, the core pain agentic EDA aims to monetize.
